Get Your Magazine Worthy Renovation In 42 Days With A Fixed Price Guaranteed - Or We Pay You $3,000

Melbourne’s only ‘Design-to-Dream Method’ brings design, cabinetry, trades, and project management under one roof - so you get a flawless, high-end renovation delivered on time, on budget, and without the horror-story chaos most homeowners experience. A Jaw-Dropping, Functional Bathroom Or Kitchen Delivered In 42 Days Without Budget Blowouts…

Picture this: Your outdated kitchen is now a bright, functional space with custom cabinetry that fits your life perfectly. Or your cramped 1980s bathroom is now a spa-like retreat with a rainfall shower and elegant tilework. The renovation happened on schedule, stayed on budget, and didn't turn your home into a construction site for months.

Sound too good to be true? This is what happens when a team with 25+ years of experience handles your entire renovation from design to installation with no outsourcing, no miscommunication between contractors, and no broken promises. Just a seamless 42-Day transformation creating a jaw-dropping, functional space.
How To Lock In Your Quote And Timeline So You Never Face A $30K Budget Ambush Or 3-Month Delay…

Most renovation companies are just middlemen. They outsource your design to one company, your cabinetry to another, and hire whoever's available for installation. Nobody's accountable for the whole project. That's why the $80,000 quote becomes $110,000. Why the "6-8 week job" drags into four months. Why you're stuck managing five contractors who blame each other when something goes wrong.

You end up cooking on a camping stove while your builder goes silent. Your finished kitchen has cabinets that don't quite line up, and your bathroom a shower screen that leaks within weeks. But this entire nightmare stems from one fixable problem: outsourcing to five different companies who've never worked together. Lock in one team that handles everything in-house, and suddenly your quote stays fixed, your timeline stays on track, and quality gets guaranteed.

items.text: Our Award-Winning, In-House Solutions Eliminate Finger-Pointing, Delays And Cost Overruns From Day One, So You Enjoy A New, Luxurious Space Sooner…

Champagne Finish works differently. Everything happens in-house with one accountable team. Our designers, cabinet makers, project manager, and installation crew work together daily. They've collaborated on hundreds of projects. When your designer creates your 3D layout, the cabinet makers review it immediately. When your custom cabinetry is being built in our Melbourne workshop, our project manager is already coordinating trusted trades. When installation begins, it's our team, not random subcontractors.

The result? No finger-pointing. No delays. No budget surprises. Your renovation starts and finishes exactly when promised, with the premium quality you expected. That's the Design-to-Dream Method, and it's why we’ve grown to a multi-million dollar renovation specialist by word-of-mouth alone.

Meet The Owner-Operator With 25+ Years Of Hands-On Experience (Who Personally Oversees Your Renovation)...

I'm Kurt Henderson, and I've spent over 25 years in this industry, from cabinet-making apprentice to registered builder. I started Champagne Finish fifteen years ago because I saw how the typical renovation model fails families who are making a significant investment. I knew there had to be a better way: one accountable team, clear communication, flawless finishes.

Today we're registered domestic builders (DB-L 72500) with an award-winning design team. We've transformed hundreds of Melbourne homes. But we're still owner-operated. I'm personally involved in every project. Your renovation isn't just another job. It's our reputation on the line.

items.text: Includes your custom 3D design plan and fixed-price quote (valued at $1,800)
Everything You're Wondering About Your Kitchen Or Bathroom Renovation (Answered Honestly)
Where do we cook and shower during the renovation?

We set up temporary solutions to keep your home functional. For kitchens, we help establish a cooking zone elsewhere. For bathrooms, we work in stages. Our 42-Day timeline means temporary arrangements last weeks, not months.
What about dust throughout our home?
We use dust containment barriers to isolate the renovation zone. We clean daily, protect floors, and keep sites tidy. You won't have dust coating your entire home.
Can we make changes once started?
Minor tweaks? Yes. Major changes after materials are ordered? Complicated and costly. That's why we perfect the 3D design upfront. You're confident before we start.
How do you guarantee 42 days?

Everything's in-house. We manufacture cabinetry in our workshop, our project manager coordinates trusted trades, our crew has done this hundreds of times. We control every variable. If we miss it, we pay you $3,000.
What if something goes wrong after?

Every project has Victoria's Builder's Warranty: six years structural, two years non-structural. Plus we're owner-operated. Kurt's reputation is on every job. If something needs fixing, call us directly.
Which Melbourne suburbs do you cover?

We service Melbourne homeowners across a defined range of inner, middle and select outer suburbs. Our work is concentrated in areas that suit our level of finish, access requirements and project scale. For projects outside these areas, availability is assessed case by case.

terms.text: Champagne Finish – Campaign Terms & Conditions
1. Eligibility
1.1 Offer is available only to homeowners located within Melbourne and surrounding suburbs serviced by Champagne Finish.
1.2 Homeowners must be over 18 years of age and the legal owner of the property undergoing renovation.
1.3 Offer is valid for kitchen and/or bathroom renovations only.
2. Free 60-Minute Design Consultation
2.1 The free consultation is limited to the next five (5) enquiries received in the campaign month.
2.2 The consultation includes design advice, scope discussion, and a personalised renovation plan.
2.3 No physical drawings or 3D renders will be provided unless a Design Agreement is entered into.
3. Fixed 42-Day Completion Guarantee
3.1 Applies only after final design approval, material selections, signed contract, and ready site.
3.2 Timeline begins on confirmed site start date.
3.3 Excludes delays caused by variations, structural issues, supplier delays, access issues, or
events beyond control.
4. $3,000 Compensation Guarantee
4.1 If Champagne Finish fails to complete within 42 days (without exclusions), client receives $3,000.
4.2 Provided as a payment or deduction.
4.3 One payment per project.
4.4 Not payable if delays fall under Clause 3.3.
5. Pricing & Variations
5.1 Pricing outlined in contract.
5.2 Variations must be approved in writing.
5.3 Variations may void the 42 day guarantee.
6. Builder’s Warranty & Insurance
6.1 Covered by Victoria’s DBI.
6.2 Structural defects: 6 years; Non-structural: 2 years.
6.3 Excludes damage caused by misuse or third-party trades.
7. Campaign Availability
7.1 Champagne Finish may update or withdraw campaign at any time.
7.2 Benefits cannot be transferred or exchanged.
8. Client Responsibilities
8.1 Site must be safe and accessible.
8.2 Clients must provide approvals and selections on time.
8.3 Delays caused by client may void guarantee eligibility.
9. Limitation of Liability
9.1 Company not liable for indirect or consequential losses.
9.2 Liability limited to Australian Consumer Law requirements.
10. Acceptance
10.1 Proceeding with consultation or contract indicates acceptance of these terms.
